summary: Plays one or more sound files directly to an audio device, with trigger/loop modes, output routing, volume, and device selection.
key_concepts: Audio Play CHOP plays supported sound files directly to an audio output device.
Audio samples do not enter or pass through TouchDesigner CHOP channels, so downstream CHOP processing is not possible.
The state channel is 1 while any file is playing and 0 otherwise.
Input 0 triggers playback, input 1 can control volume, and input 2 can control pan.
DAT List mode lets one CHOP trigger multiple listed files individually by channel.

key_params.name: mode
key_params.note: Play while on, trigger, or loop mode

key_params.name: trigger
key_params.note: Trigger playback when in trigger mode

key_params.name: cookalways
key_params.note: Cook every frame for responsive triggering

common_gotchas: Audio Play CHOP plays to a device rather than outputting audio samples for further CHOP processing.
DAT file lists need valid paths and stable row ordering for deterministic triggers.
Trigger and loop modes behave differently from Play While On; choose based on desired transport semantics.
For processed audio chains, prefer Audio File In CHOP plus filters/dynamics and Audio Device Out CHOP.
